鼠鼠.definition: A [word was] created from Baidu.com's Tiebar(a China's app),which is often used to address oneself in Tiebar to replace 'I' or 'me' for self mockey at the beginning,but now is get usual in Tiebar and its meaning breaks away from self mockey gradually.When it spreads to the Bilibili (It is also an China's app),it became the pronoun of Chen Rui(Bilibili's CEO,who was [controversial]) because its [pronunciation] in Chinese sounds like 'uncle' which is Chen's nickname.
鼠鼠.example:
1.鼠鼠长这么丑，想紫砂了
Shushu is so ugly and I wanna commit suicide.
2.鼠鼠我啊，最喜欢钱了
I,the Shushu,like [the money] [more than] [anything].
